title: One enhanced output of one configuration for one population pair (data/manifests/phase3/runs/<population>/<config>.csv.gz)

pair_id.description: fes-syn-v1 pair id; links to the population row → clean reference + degraded input

error.description: empty when OK; exception type + message when FAILED

output_sha256.description: PNG file bytes; empty when FAILED

output_pixel_sha256.description: raw 224x224x3 uint8 BGR buffer; determinism checks compare this

infer_s.description: adapter.enhance wall time under concurrent load (not P3-T8)

meta_json.description: adapter metadata (e.g. f_coverage, fbcnn_pred_qf) or traceback
